annotations.title: Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft bulk sender requirements

description: The bulk sender requirements, sorted honestly: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX checked from DNS; forward and reverse DNS when given the sending IP; one-click unsubscribe and From alignment when given a received message's raw headers; and the requirements no outside tool can see (complaint rate, per-connection TLS) named as not checked rather than passed.

headers.description: Optional: raw headers of a message they sent, as received, to check one-click unsubscribe and alignment.

ip.description: Optional: the sending IP, only if they run their own mail server.
